messages.content: 今天北京的日落時間是什麼時候？

function.name: calculate_sunrise
function.description: Calculate the time of sunrise for a specific date and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which sunrise time needs to be calculated.

date.description: The date for which sunrise time needs to be calculated in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, current date is considered. Default: 1998-12-03

format.description: Format in which the time should be returned. If not provided, default format 'HH:MM' is considered.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to calculate sunset times. The tool I have access to can only give me sunrise times. If you’d like, I can tell you when the sun rises in Beijing today.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天北京的日落时间是什么时候?" They want sunset time. But the tool only calculates sunrise. We cannot compute sunset directly. We could approximate or say we can't provide sunset. According to policy, we can respond with best effort. We might mention that we can calculate sunrise but not sunset. So we can say we don't have sunset data. Or we can approximate using sunrise + daylight length? But no daylight length function. So we should politely say we can only calculate sunrise.
